issues.description: Constructor signature mismatch for class Bookstore: the problem statement requires an initializer with signature init(books: [Book]) (problem_statement.md lines 9-12). In solution_repository/Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift the class defines init(books: [Book], valid: Bool) (signature at line 14), but in solution_repository/Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift the code instantiates the bookstore as Bookstore(books: books) (call at line 57). The extra 'valid: Bool' parameter in the solution's initializer conflicts with the required API and with the call site, causing a compilation error or confusion about how students should instantiate Bookstore.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Bookstore initializer consistent with the problem statement and call site: change the initializer in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift to init(books: [Book]) (remove the extra 'valid: Bool' parameter). Alternatively, if the extra parameter is required for implementation reasons, give it a default value (e.g. valid: Bool = true) and update the problem statement and template to document the additional parameter so all artifacts share the same constructor contract.
